method: Read-only RGBA inspection using Pillow; each aligned 4x4 block must be constant for a proposed 4x integer upscale. This measures only that hypothesis; it does not grade artistic quality or prove all other possible grids. No image editing or resampling performed.

images.grid_check_scope: Diagnostic comparison only; v05 is a history-rich magical visual concept and does not claim an exact 4x native grid.
images.perceptual_review: Preserves the original scene/layout, two people, turtle, prop categories, elevated camera and warm core palette. Material history is more legible through irregular aged masonry with reused carved stones, differently colored bridge planks, braced wheel timber, mismatched roof tiles, tarnished chest fittings and a visibly staple-repaired ceramic pot. Stream rocks show stylized bands and erosion cues. Repaired objects coexist with working equipment, clear paths and lush tended planting, so the place remains inhabited and cared for. Ambient glitter is reduced; magic is concentrated in old marks, the turtle shell and botanical accents. Some history cues, particularly the pot repair and repeated spiral carvings, are prominent stylizations rather than subtle archaeological evidence. This image communicates a direction; it does not prove a physically causal history model, exact sprite identity across frames, native-grid production fidelity or animation readiness. Final style acceptance remains open.

images.perceptual_review: Retains the same composition, original people and creature, prop categories, camera, palette and lived-in material cues. Faces, the path and workshop read more readily; repaired ceramic, mixed bridge timber, worn foundations, crafted chest and lantern still provide focal detail. The floral reduction is more conspicuous than a literal small percentage trim, although overall foliage remains lush and core craftsmanship is retained. Some tiny direction-study details are regenerated. This remains a proposed refinement; final style selection, native-grid sprite fidelity and animation readiness are not established.
